method.source_read_mode: Fresh factory-startup Blender 5.2.2 process; --disable-autoexec; threads 1; Python exit code configured before Python script.
method.broad_support_scan: Conservative visible evaluated mesh-island AABB union at 5.0001 mm, plus all visible curve/font bounds. A disconnected cluster proves lack of any geometric contact to all outside geometry within that limit. A connected AABB component does not establish actual or intended support.
method.float_tolerance_crosscheck: Increasing union threshold to 5.001 mm joins the receiver and C01 clusters but still leaves their combined assembly >=14.00018 mm from all outside geometry.
method.targeted_surface_scan: Bidirectional full-vertex-to-evaluated-surface BVH proximity, followed by directed rays from actual source-surface witnesses. These rays measure a concrete gap along the recorded path; vertex-to-surface minima are sampled upper bounds, not an exhaustive triangle-triangle minimum. Conservative AABB separation provides the lower-bound proof.
method.architecture_roots: Actual room Floor/West wall/East wall/Entry walls/Rear walls/Decon walls/Ceiling/Decon floor/Decon ceiling, not all inherited object names.

existing_verifier_replay.limitation: Assembly support traversal treats a baseline inherited-name match as the room root. That allows new additions to pass while their inherited compound host remains detached from actual structure.

interpretation.confirmed_major: Battery rail/module cluster, cabinet pane/face/handle cluster, suit service enclosure cluster, combined receiver/C01 cluster, decon ceiling fixture and detached mechanical hardware have physical substrate or load-path omissions. Plaque backings also lack their intended spacer contact.
interpretation.raised_prints: The engraved glyphs sit approximately 1.85 mm off their backing plaques, within the recommended 5 mm gap; glyph relief alone is not a separate blocker. The detached plaque backing is the failed substrate.
interpretation.raised_display: Telemetry status bar.002 is a 3 mm thick raised element 5.49984 mm off Monitor dark face. It may be intended display relief, but needs an explicit substrate/contact contract or scoped justification; it is listed separately from major load-bearing omissions.
interpretation.hidden_artifacts: All listed clusters contain render-enabled source geometry. Camera occlusion does not exempt mechanical parts from the support contract. The reserve screwdriver slots are stranded below the rotated door and separated from their original fixed screw heads.

actionable_repair: Preserve original layout and matrices. Add authored load-bearing mounting returns, rails, brackets, screw shoulders or thin plaque spacers that connect each exact component to its intended carcass/frame/architecture. A nearest rubber seal, unrelated crossing part, open door or touching bounding box is not by itself an acceptable intended support. Register every new mechanism and validate the host cluster-to-architecture path as well as internal contacts.
